verified_positive_evidence: A holdout binding turns a distinct target Project into a frozen external-period challenge; assert_iterative_research_allowed rejects candidate Sessions and research Campaigns in bound Projects.
Generic execute_study is rejected on a bound Project unless the call is holdout-authorized, so the target cannot silently fall back into the ordinary research loop.

The agent work brief for a bound target is non-writable and exposes holdout.run as the primary action; the public test checks that session.start is absent and that start_session raises holdout.frozen-project.
run_holdout is logically idempotent after publication: if the result directory already exists it returns load_holdout_result instead of evaluating again.

Within an incomplete holdout, each lane is keyed by the expected study input hash. _matching_partial_run reuses the single matching persisted Run and rejects duplicate matching executions; a missing lane alone is executed with holdout_authorized=True.
Result publication uses a staging directory and os.replace; the completed result records authority.selectionAllowed=false and tradingAuthority=none.
The public one-shot test runs the holdout, calls run_holdout again, and asserts the same result ID and identical lane run IDs, then observes state=completed and only assessment/show actions.
The challenge requires a strictly later non-overlapping target period and freezes source candidate bytes into the target binding.
important_scope_and_gaps: This is a frozen external audit mechanism for quantitative research, not an end-to-end LLM self-improvement system with a proposer/promotion e-process.

The holdout target is terminal for iterative research from binding onward, but the original source Project remains a separate object; the code does not by itself prove an operator cannot manually use the revealed holdout result to launch new research elsewhere.

Logical reruns after a completed result are read-only, and persisted per-lane Runs are reused during resume, but no real-SIGKILL test was found that proves exactly-once evaluator/provider consumption at every point inside execute_study before its Run artifact becomes durable.
There is no separate candidate-local anytime-valid CERTIFY stage before the external holdout and no restart-durable cross-candidate FDR/FWER/alpha-wealth ledger.
The final assessment is interpretive review of the frozen holdout evidence; it is not an additional untouched fourth statistical surface.

design_update.stronger_outer_pattern: Freeze the evaluation target into a distinct project/namespace whose ordinary candidate-generation and research commands are structurally disabled before any outer evaluation. Make completed outer evaluation read-only, and resume incomplete evaluation by stable content-bound sub-evaluation identity rather than restarting the whole challenge.
composition_target: candidate-local anytime-valid CERTIFY on a distinct certification surface
frozen external OUTER target with iterative research disabled
durable logical outer-query identity before dispatch and provider/evaluator reconciliation
completed OUTER reads are cache-only; no new evaluation

exact_next_action: Search for a public self-improvement implementation that combines Auto-Quant-V2-like terminal frozen external evaluation and replay-safe completed results with Harn/GitMoot/LOGOS-like candidate-local anytime-valid certification and durable candidate-crossing statistical spending. Prioritize code/tests with stable logical evaluation IDs prepared before dispatch, real crash/restart tests, and an outer namespace where optimization commands are structurally unavailable after or throughout evaluation.
